dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
My car was stolen!
They stole my car!
Hey! My car is gone!
{ADDRESS} What's the address of where this happened, sir?
It happened at [[ADDRESS]]
345 Oxygen Road
124 2nd Alley
504 Basic Square
What's your name, sir?
My name is John Belloic.
I'm Richard Swenty.
My name's Robert Fortier.
{WHEN?} When was your car stolen?
Just now! I saw the thieves driving away in my car! Send somebody to catch them!
I just saw that my car is gone, but I've no idea when it happened.
I don't know. I've left my car about an hour ago.
{IT'S NOT AN EMERGENCY} Sir, it isn't an emergency case, please report the theft to the nearest police station.
Of course... Thank you for the help and sorry for blocking the line. Goodbye.
Awww, come on.....
This is the number to the police, isn't it? Just send somebody, ok? I haven't got time to go looking for cops.
{DON'T BLOCK THE LINE} Sir, please do not block the line. Your case is not urgent enough to call 911.
Oh, really? Somebody stole my car and this is nothing for you? You're responsible for sending police here! I'll file a complaint. Maybe that will be urgent enough for you!
{LET ME EXPLAIN} Excuse me, sir, but we've a limited number of police vehicles available. Because of that, I can only send units to cases, which require immediate response. Yours is not one of them.
Eh.... what a bullshit. I want to talk with your supervisor right now.
{YOU'RE BLOCKING THE LINE} Let me decide, what I'm responsible for, okay? You're wasting time of 911 operator and tying up emergency lines. Goodbye.
{I'LL SEND POLICE}Ok, I will send a police patrol.
{POLICE WILL COME} Ok, I will send an officer when I have one available.
Thank you. I'll wait for them.
{WHERE?} Where did it happen?
In front of the shopping mall.
In the middle of a street! While I was waiting at the red light, he just dragged me out of my car and drove away!
The car was in the parking lot of my apartment building.
{MAYBE IT WAS ELSEWHERE?} Maybe you left your car somewhere else?
No, I always park here.
No, rather not.
Hmmm... I don't think so... No, wait! How could I forget that?! It is a wrong row. Sorry!
{NO PROBLEM} No problem, sir. Everyone makes mistakes. But next time before calling 911, please check twice if it's really necessary.
{ARE YOU SURE?} Sir, are you completely sure that your car is not at another parking space?
Please, don't treat me like an idiot. I just said I'm sure.
Yes, yes, I'm 100% sure.

{CONTACT LOCAL POLICE STATION} I'm sorry to hear that your car was stolen, but I can't do anything about that. This is not an emergency case and you should contact your local police station. They will help you out.
{WERE YOU PARKING LEGALLY?} Sir, are you sure you didn't park your car in no parking zone, a driveway or a bus stop?
I'm sure I didn't. It was a normal parking place.
Emm . . . . . . . . . I was . . . . . . . . . Damn it . . . . . . . . . There is a 'No Parking' sign... I just realized that. Sorry. How can I get my car back?
{YOUR CAR WAS TOWED}Your car was towed to the police impound yard. Just contact the police on their non emergency number, they will help you out.
Thank you. Goodbye.
{THE POLICE WILL COME} We're notifying the officers in the area now. They will see if they can find your car.
{HOW MANY?} So how many suspects did you see?
There were two of them.
Three... I guess.
It's hard to say, it all happened really fast. I didn't even know what was going on.
{PLATES?} I am gonna need your license plates number, could you give it to me, please?
It's [[PLATES]].
It's [[PLATES]].
It's [[PLATES]].
It's [[PLATES]].
{COLOR?} What is the color of your car?
{CAR TYPE?} What is the type of your car?
It was a van.
Just a 4 door family sedan.
Muscle car. Expensive one!
Thank you. Goodbye.
Do you know where my car is?
Hey, are you still talking with me?

reportElement.texten: The operator decided that the case is not urgent enough to send an emergency unit.
The caller disagreed with operator's decision and filed a claim.
Despite the aggressive caller, the operator remained calm and thanks to that the supervisor finds the complaint unfounded.
The operator was provoked by the caller and ended the call.
Under the caller's pressure, the operator agreed to send the police for a non-emergency situation.
The operator decided to send the police to the place, where the car was stolen.
During the conversation the operator discovered that the car was not stolen and help is unnecessary.
The operator sent the police unit to chase thieves.
